description: This file defines the GraphSignature class and related functions for managing and validating graph signatures in the torch::nativert namespace, including input/output specifications, name validation, and symbol handling.

classes.name: GraphSignature
classes.description: Represents the signature of a computational graph, including input/output specifications, validation, and name replacement functionalities.

methods.name: GraphSignature
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GraphSignature object from a serialized storage, validating input order and processing inputs/outputs.

methods.name: inputNames
methods.description: Returns a set of input names used in the graph signature.

methods.name: outputNames
methods.description: Returns a set of output names used in the graph signature.

methods.name: lint
methods.description: Validates the input and output names against the graph's actual inputs and outputs.

methods.name: replaceAllUses
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a given name with a new name throughout the signature.
